cycle_compile_ns.note: crates/space profile stages over the replay's cycle rebinds: 0 roots/bound, 1 cuts, 2 integration, 3 conversion; built with --features emergent-space/profile

jet.note: the law's jet (docs/law.md 'strong-field reuse … re-anchored') replayed bench-side: fold the kick's Δv into the residual against the pre-kick binding (the cycle is kept; the readout between kicks is the same table read), re-anchor with an exact from_state when the accumulated |dv|/|v| crosses sqrt(floor/C) (C=1.88, floor=1e-6, redteam-df81); implied_jet_kick_us = whole - from_state + fold + anchor
